prompts.prompt: Photorealistic scientific 3D render in the style of a high-end medical animation still: macro photography look, subsurface scattering, translucent living tissue, soft wet sheen, fine surface texture, cinematic lighting. A single layer of very thin, flat, scale-like simple squamous epithelial cells, fitted together like irregular paving stones. Every cell is much wider than it is thick. Each cell outline is irregular, with wavy, interlocking borders and a narrow dark groove between neighbouring cells. Each cell has exactly one oval nucleus near its centre that makes a small rounded bulge in the flat top surface; the nuclei are a darker mauve than the cytoplasm, and faint darker granules show inside the cytoplasm. The layer rests on a thin basement membrane. Just behind and below the far edge of the layer, softly out of focus, a capillary carrying red blood cells (biconcave discs), very close to the thin layer: the short path for exchange. Keep the space above the layer clear: no floating spheres, bubbles, droplets or particles. The camera looks down at the layer at about 35 degrees from the horizontal. Wide 16:9 landscape framing: the layer fills the lower four fifths of the frame and runs off the left, right and bottom edges; its far edge crosses the upper part of the frame, with darkness above it. Shallow depth of field: sharp on the cell in the centre, the nearest cells and everything behind the far edge softly blurred. Soft warm key light from the upper left, a cool blue rim light from behind that outlines each nucleus bulge and cell edge, faint volumetric haze in the distance. Warm pink-mauve tissue lit from within, darker mauve nuclei, a deep navy-black background. Do not show cilia, microvilli, stacked layers, tall column-shaped or cube-shaped cells, cells with two or more nuclei, a regular hexagonal honeycomb, cartoon outlines or flat illustration shading. Absolutely no text of any kind: no letters, words, numbers, labels, arrows, captions, watermark, logo, signature, scale bar, border or user interface anywhere in the image.
